structured_output.summary: Wing balcony walk is NOT lit: the two hanging lanterns (x50, x56; chains y15..16, lantern y14) are refused by runParts because the shell locks the walk's air. The room module is restored to empty and build.nbt rebuilds clean (no refusals). On a scratch copy the designer's layout lights all 9 walk cells to min 9, mean 10.8, 0 dark, so the layout is right and only the placement is blocked.
left: The shell (parts/shell.mjs, wing carve around z62 y11..16) must place iron_chain at (50,15..16,62) and (56,15..16,62) and hanging lantern at (50,14,62) and (56,14,62). This lamplighter part cannot: runParts refuses all six writes into the shell's air.
Until the shell does this, `mcd room build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only "wing balcony walk"` exits 1 with 9 dark cells (min 0), so the room is not OK.
make.sh reports OFF-PALETTE roof blocks (tuff_brick_slab, tuff_bricks, cobbled_deepslate_stairs, polished_deepslate_slab and others) from the roof step. Not mine, but roof.json needs fixing.

waste.what: Checking whether the designer's lanterns would light the walk: I wrote a scratch loader that copied build.nbt, set the chains and lanterns with g.set, and saved a probe copy, then ran the room and light checks on it. Also two full make.sh rebuilds to see the refusals and restore the module.
waste.cost: about 6 tool calls, 2 full builds, one scratch script in /tmp (deleted afterwards)
waste.tool: A dry-run option on runParts or mcd room, e.g. `mcd room build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only X --try 'iron_chain@50,15,62' --try 'lantern[hanging=true]@50,14,62'`, that lights candidate lamps without the part lock and reports which writes would be refused. Also a rule in the room-part template that the lock refusal be known before the build runs.
